```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp import Server
from fastmcp.client.async_client import AsyncClient


async def main():
    # Create an existing FastMCP server
    server = Server("test-server")

    # Register a resource at "data://config"
    @server.resource("data://config")
    async def config_resource():
        return "configuration data content"

    # Connect an in-memory client directly to the server
    async with AsyncClient(server) as client:
        # Fetch the resource contents
        content = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print(content)


asyncio.run(main())
```
